instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include a `data-testid` attribute for robust automated testing.
Implement full form state preservation in the New Product form when navigating to Create New Collection and back.
Ensure newly created collection appears immediately in All Collections and is automatically selected upon returning to the New Product form.
Use Sonner for toast notifications and Shadcn primitives for UI components.
Ensure there are no transparent headers or dropdowns without solid backgrounds.
Use .js/.jsx files as standard in this React app.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop aesthetic; use deliberate spacing, crisp borders, and refined color harmony.
Ensure generous padding (p-6, p-8) on cards and containers.
Include hover states and micro-interactions on all buttons and inputs.
Never use universal transition: all; apply specific property transitions.
